title: Knowledge Tracing & Student Modelling

blueprintSignals.name: Recent correctness with recency weighting
blueprintSignals.definition: exponentially weighted correct rate per skill

blueprintSignals.name: Time-since-last-practice
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use server-side timestamps because device clocks drift

blueprintSignals.name: Prior failures on the skill
blueprintSignals.definition: count of earlier wrong answers on the same skill
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Count only answers given before the current one

blueprintSignals.name: Question difficulty from other learners
blueprintSignals.definition: smoothed correct rate of the question among training students
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Compute on training students only, never including the learner being scored

label: For "Knowledge Tracing & Student Modelling": Estimate each learner's evolving mastery per skill from their answer history to drive practice selection and progress reports. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Predicting next answers with student leakage.
